milestones.browser_process_launch_diagnostic: Chromium launch request through process connection. Retained as a diagnostic and excluded from application comparisons.
milestones.browser_page_startup_diagnostic: Connected Chromium through context/page creation, navigation, visible file input, and two animation frames. Retained as a diagnostic and excluded from application comparisons.
milestones.browser_load_to_dashboard_paint: File selection through stream, WASM analysis, state commit, and two animation frames.
milestones.browser_timers_tab_paint: Timers click handler through Solid mount and two animation frames. Includes chart and frame-table construction.
milestones.browser_timeline_load: Worst-marker handler through retained query, state commit, and two animation frames for the SVG timeline.
milestones.browser_application_through_first_timeli: Sum of the in-page file-load, Timers-tab-paint, and timeline-load spans. Browser startup plus automation intervals between handlers are excluded.
milestones.unreal_analysis: Unreal Insights' own 'Analysis has completed in' duration; excludes process startup.
milestones.unreal_process_to_timers_ready_diagnosti: Process launch until the first Timers aggregated-stats completion log. Retained as a diagnostic, not used for ratios, and not a Slate paint event.
